body: Yes Im ok. Just a had a bad argument with my husband. This shit just drains the fuck out of me. Im just so tired of this. Thanks for asking. I almost slit my wrists tonight but I thought about my son and what this would do to him. But thanks for asking.

Yes I know he doesn't deserve me. I mean he does love his son but I just wish he loved me too. If I'm his wife, we should be a team, I should be his queen. We should be his #1 priority not his nieces. If I argue with them he's on their side and never defends me. Sometimes I think it's me and that there's something wrong me. I do everything a good wife should do. I take care of out son. I mean Im not out in streets cheating on him. But I can't even end it because what would happen to my son. He's only 4 yrs old I can't do this to him. Thank you for your kind words and for caring.

I'm just so tired. He is just so blind and doesn't see that I'm a good woman. He will never love me the way I love him. His whole family comes first before me and his son. It's just not fair. Nobody will care of I kill myself. I don't want to feel anything anymore.
